caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden candle stand positioned centrally on a light beige background. The candle stand is rendered in shades of brown, showing grain patterns to suggest a polished wood surface. It features a circular, flat tabletop supported by a single, tapered central column that extends downward and branches into three symmetrically curved legs, each touching the ground at equal intervals. The legs have a gentle arc, providing stability to the stand. There is a lighter rectangular shadow underneath the stand, giving a sense of depth and grounding the object. Centered below the stand, the label “Candle Stand” is written in a simple gray font. In the lower right corner, there is a signature. The overall composition is minimal, keeping the focus on the candle stand itself.
title: Shaker Table
